# Paradigms

Paradigms are fundamental styles or approaches to programming that dictate how a developer organizes and executes code. They define the structural logic of a program, offering different ways to solve problems by choosing how to represent data and functions. In Python, these paradigmsΓÇösuch as object-oriented, procedural, and functional programmingΓÇöcan be used individually or combined, allowing developers to choose the most effective strategy for the specific task at hand.
